verdict.rationale: Foreloop ships an official globally-installable CLI (npm i -g foreloop) that manages projects, loops, intentions, stories, and tasks, supports scripting via `--json` with a stable additive schema, and is explicitly designed to be run 'from anything that can run one, including coding agents and cron,' making it clearly AI-native/agentic-workflow friendly. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and more detail on full command surface.
